def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Try several pressure-aware greedy orders and retain the best local placement."""
    if gpu_num <= 0:
        raise ValueError("gpu_num must be positive")

    values = {id(m): m.req_rate / m.slo for m in models}
    orders = [
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, values[id(m)]), reverse=True),
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: (values[id(m)], m.model_size), reverse=True),
        sorted(models, key=lambda m: values[id(m)] / max(m.model_size, 1e-12),
               reverse=True),
    ]
    best = None
    best_score = float("inf")

    for order in orders:
        groups = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
        used = [0.0] * gpu_num
        load = [0.0] * gpu_num

        for model in order:
            v = values[id(model)]
            choices = [i for i in range(gpu_num)
                       if used[i] + model.model_size <= GPU_MEM_SIZE]
            if not choices:
                raise ValueError("Models do not fit in the available GPUs")
            i = min(
                choices,
                key=lambda j: ((load[j] + v) /
                               (GPU_MEM_SIZE - used[j] - model.model_size),
                              load[j] / max(GPU_MEM_SIZE - used[j], 1e-12))
            )
            groups[i].append(model)
            used[i] += model.model_size
            load[i] += v

        def score():
            return max(load[i] / (GPU_MEM_SIZE - used[i])
                       if used[i] < GPU_MEM_SIZE else float("inf")
                       for i in range(gpu_num))

        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            current = score()
            for src in range(gpu_num):
                for model in list(groups[src]):
                    v = values[id(model)]
                    for dst in range(gpu_num):
                        if src == dst or used[dst] + model.model_size > GPU_MEM_SIZE:
                            continue
                        groups[src].remove(model)
                        groups[dst].append(model)
                        used[src] -= model.model_size
                        used[dst] += model.model_size
                        load[src] -= v
                        load[dst] += v
                        if score() + 1e-12 < current:
                            changed = True
                            break
                        groups[dst].remove(model)
                        groups[src].append(model)
                        used[src] += model.model_size
                        used[dst] -= model.model_size
                        load[src] += v
                        load[dst] -= v
                    if changed:
                        break
                if changed:
                    break

        value = score()
        if value < best_score:
            best_score = value
            best = {i: list(groups[i]) for i in range(gpu_num)}

    return best
